q: What share of our customers have ordered more than once, and are new customers or repeat customers worth more?
answer:
About 25% of our customers in the last 30 days have ordered more than once. Repeat customers are worth more on average, spending ₹2,218 each compared to ₹1,783 for new customers.

- Total net sales were ₹18,77,686, with ₹13,38,818 from new customers and ₹5,38,868 from repeat customers.
- New customers made up 77.8% of the customer base, while repeat customers accounted for 25.2%.
- The higher average spend by repeat customers suggests they are more valuable individually.

Worth considering: strategies to increase the repeat rate, as repeat customers contribute more per order. 

Period: 2026-09-29–2026-10-28 · Currency: INR · Data as of 2026-10-29
